integrity: A self-contained analytic proof establishes the universal bound. Exact radical and integer-coordinate checks support explicit witnesses; finite numerical trials are supplementary and do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Only convex equiangular pentagons, closed side-diameter disks; the separation coefficient is explicit but not optimal. No classification of all possible five-disk graphs or higher-gon extension is claimed.
title: A sharp eight-edge bound and a uniform separation law for side disks of equiangular pentagons
